findings.failure_path: After a ledger binds reviewed changes, add and commit specs/new-round/evidence/payload.py (or another non-ledger artifact). Git reports it as added, EVIDENCE_MEMBER matches it, the path is excluded from candidate computation, and the unchanged ledger can still pass while the unreviewed file lands.
findings.smallest_fix: Exclude only current-round files that are positively identified and validated as controller-generated evidence artifacts; bind or refuse every other addition under an evidence directory. Add a regression test that commits an arbitrary script there and expects the candidate to move or the gate to refuse it.

skipped_clients.reason: claude belongs to the implementer model family

concern_results.conclusion: The computed exclusion admits any newly added file under specs/<name>/evidence/, not only a validated receipt. Such a file does not change the reviewed candidate, so an existing valid ledger can authorize a commit containing unreviewed content.

Dirty bound paths are refused, but the containment tests explicitly accept an unrelated added evidence file and never test executable or otherwise unsafe additions. The high-risk boundary therefore remains bypassable.
